feed_summary: This release adds multiple new modules, and 6 of those modules point at a single target: Langflow , the open-source LLM workflow builder. Together they cover an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-93680), 3 unauthenticated remote code execution paths (CVE-2026-0768, CVE-2026-0769, and CVE-2026-10134), and 2 authenticated code execution flaws (CVE-2026-7873 and CVE-2026-93674), spanning Langflow releases from 1.0.0 through 1.11.4. Thanks to the work of rmhowe425 , with research credit to Peter Girnus and n0k0. Beyond Langflow, open source contributor kmkz contributed a pre-auth RCE chain against OpenCTI. MongoDB coverage has also been expanded with 3 new auxiliary modules plus an Apache Solr version scanner thanks to the work of community member h00die . New Module Content (11) 4gaBoards Mass U
title: Metasploit Wrap Up: Langflow, MongoDB, and More
